description: This file defines the ShadingRenderer class responsible for rendering shading effects onto a graphics context within the MigraDoc document rendering library. It includes methods for rendering rectangles and rounded corners with shading, and manages brush realization based on shading properties.

classes.name: ShadingRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders shading effects onto a graphics context, supporting rectangle and rounded corner rendering with shading properties.

methods.name: ShadingRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with graphics context and shading object.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders a rectangle with shading at specified position and size.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders a rectangle with shading and optional rounded corners.

methods.name: IsVisible
methods.description: Determines if the shading is visible based on its properties.

methods.name: RealizeBrush
methods.description: Creates the brush used for shading based on shading properties and visibility.
